note: Franklin County KS: the county's zoning map (linked from its GIS maps page) and the county zoning regulations are published as PDF/document files, not a queryable ArcGIS service. The county's ArcGIS server (services1.arcgis.com/Cdr6tOjJ99MjOR6x) has county, city-limit, parcel and district layers but no zoning districts layer. Ottawa and Wellsville publish zoning as PDF maps. The Princeton, KS zoning service found is not for Kansas (it is Princeton, Texas), and the Zoning_Districts layer on services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd is not Ottawa, KS.
